dedupe.description: Group repeated messages into one row with count, first_seen and last_seen (default true). Set to false for the raw entries.

job_id.description: Optional workflow_run_id to filter logs for a specific sync job. Get this from external-data-sources-jobs.

level.description: Minimum log level to return. Defaults to INFO (excludes DEBUG).

limit.description: Max number of raw log entries to read per table (default 100), newest first. Also caps the rows returned.

schema_id.description: UUID of the table (schema) to get sync logs for, from external-data-schemas-list or the `schemas` of external-data-sources-retrieve. This is not the source id. Pass this or source_id.

search.description: Search string to filter log messages (case-insensitive substring match).

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Only return entries after it (e.g. "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"). Defaults to 7 days ago.

source_id.description: UUID of a data warehouse source. Reads the logs of its failed or syncing tables (up to 10, failed tables first) and merges them. Pass this or schema_id.

until.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Only return entries before it.
